description: Create or delete customers in Alerta with the REST API.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: The access token for the API.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password for the API using basic auth.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username for the API using basic auth.

parameters.name: match
parameters.description: The matching logged in user for the customer.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the customer should exist or not. Both customer and match identify a customer that should be added or removed. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create customer
  community.general.alerta_customer:
    alerta_url: https://alerta.example.com
    api_username: admin@example.com
    api_password: password
    customer: Developer
    match: dev@example.com

- name: Delete customer
  community.general.alerta_customer:
    alerta_url: https://alerta.example.com
    api_username: admin@example.com
    api_password: password
    customer: Developer
    match: dev@example.com
    state: absent

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Customer customer1 created"

return_values.name: response
return_values.description: The response from the API. Returned: always
